items.quote: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to tell Aaron that no descendant of Aaron, in any generation, who has a physical blemish may come forward to offer the bread of God.
items.actor: the LORD (speaking to Moses, to be relayed to Aaron)
items.action: forbids from approaching to make offerings
items.object: any descendant of Aaron who has a blemish
items.mechanism: A religious rule given by God's command: having a blemish bars a man of Aaron's line from making the offering of 'the bread of his God'.
